vol.name: Fall of the House of Slaughter

name: TPB
title: Fall of the House of Slaughter #1
desc:
A new era rises from the ashes of the House of Slaughter in this thrilling new chapter!

The House of Slaughter has suffered war, betrayal, and the shattering revelations that brought its legacy to the brink—but in the aftermath of those final events and with the destruction of their house, new threats still await and a dangerous question begins to rise:

What happens when the monsters aren't the only things worth fearing?

Eisner- and GLAAD-nominated writer Tate Brombal and cartoonist Adriano Turtulici reveal what's become of the House and its surviving hunters in this thrilling follow-up to the breakout spin-off series, now available for the first time ever in one complete edition!

Collects Fall of the House of Slaughter #1-4.
